Patient has worsening shortness of breath, elevated jugular venous pressure, and decreased ejection fraction, indicating acute decompensated heart failure.
Patient has elevated creatinine levels, indicating chronic kidney disease.

Patient has an electrocardiogram showing a wide QRS rhythm and atrial tachycardia, indicating cardiac arrhythmia.
Patient has elevated jugular venous pressure, bilateral lung crackles, and a prominent S3 on cardiac auscultation, indicating volume overload.
